Overview of Fresno County Superior Court – Downtown

As the primary judicial center for Fresno County, the Downtown Courthouse handles high-volume criminal, civil, and family law cases. Part of California’s state court system, it oversees felony trials, major lawsuits, contested divorces, and probate disputes. With multiple courtrooms and departments, this facility is vital for legal proceedings in the San Joaquin Valley.

Location & Contact Details

Address:


1100 Van Ness Avenue, Fresno, CA 93724
Google Maps: Directions to Fresno County Superior Court
Phone: 559-457-2000
Website: Fresno County Superior Court

Operating Hours

  • Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Saturday & Sunday: Closed

Note: Courtroom schedules vary by judge and case type. Verify your hearing time on official paperwork.

Types of Cases Handled

  • Criminal: Felonies (murder, robbery, drug crimes)
  • Civil: High-stakes personal injury, medical malpractice, business disputes
  • Family Law: Divorce, child custody, domestic violence orders
  • Probate: Wills, estates, guardianships

Navigating the Courthouse


Security Screening:

  • Arrive 30+ minutes early for metal detectors and bag checks.
  • Prohibited items: Weapons, pepper spray, drugs.

Courtroom Layout:

  • First Floor: Courtrooms 101+ (odd north, even south).
  • Higher floors follow similar numbering (200s, 300s).
  • Spectator seating at the rear; silence devices and remain quiet.

Services & Resources

  • Self-Help Center: Assistance for self-represented individuals.
  • Mediation: Resolve disputes without trial.
  • Language Interpreters: Request in advance (Spanish and others available).
  • Online Tools:
    • Case Search: Check Status Here
    • E-Filing: Submit documents remotely.
    • Fine Payments: Traffic tickets and fees Pay Online

Visitor Tips

  • Attire: Business casual (avoid hats, revealing clothing).
  • Documents: Bring ID, case number, and paperwork.
  • Parking: Limited onsite; consider public transport or nearby garages.

Online Resources

  • Case Records: Access dockets, rulings, and calendars.
  • Forms: Download civil, family, or probate documents.
  • Legal Aid: Connect with Central California Legal Aid or California Rural Legal Assistance.

Fresno County Court Directory

  1. B.F. Sisk Courthouse
    • 1130 O Street, Fresno | 559-457-2000
  2. Criminal Courts (Dept. 95 & 96)
    • 1265 M Street, Fresno | 559-457-2000
  3. Juvenile Delinquency Facility
    • 3333 E. American Ave | 559-457-4810

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: How do I search for a court case online?
A: Use the online portal with case number or party name.

Q: Can I pay fines remotely?
A: Yes! Traffic tickets and fees are payable online via the court website.

Q: What if I need an interpreter?
A: Notify the court clerk in advance to arrange language services.

Q: Are cell phones allowed inside?
A: Yes, but silence them and avoid use in courtrooms.

Q: Where can I get legal help if I can’t afford a lawyer?
A: Visit the Self-Help Center or contact Central California Legal Aid.

Key Links

  • California Courts Self-Help Guide
  • Fresno County Law Library
  • Small Claims Assistance

Final Tips for Your Visit


Preparation is key! Double-check courtroom numbers, arrive early, and utilize online tools to streamline your experience. The Fresno County Superior Court – Downtown strives to make justice accessible—leverage its resources for a smoother legal journey.
